entities.name: Gastrointestinal angiodysplasia
observations: In older adults, gastrointestinal angiodysplasia can cause painless lower-GI bleeding; review literature describes endoscopic diagnosis and management (PMID:24138285).
Endoscopic treatment is standard for bleeding gastrointestinal angiodysplastic lesions; systematic review/meta-analysis evaluated management (PMID:24642577).

entities.name: Angiodysplasia cautery
observations: Bleeding gastrointestinal angiodysplastic lesions are treated endoscopically; the answer choice corresponding to cauterization of an AVM fits this approach (PMID:24642577; PMID:24138285).
